_meta.windowConvention: offer.window is stored as OFFSETS from the demo epoch: { startOffsetHours, durationHours }. The epoch is midnight ET of demo day zero. Negative startOffsetHours = already running. window: null = always-on (gated by availability and business rules). demoClock.materializeWindow() turns offsets into real ISO instants at load; offer.lifecycleState is DERIVED at runtime and is null in this file.
_meta.lifecycleNote: EVT120 reveal items carry parentEvent + revealIndex and NO window of their own — the lifecycle engine derives reveal i as parent.start + i * revealCadenceHours, revealCadenceHours long. FIN items carry parentEvent with a window of their own (a finale caps the event).
_meta.onAirNote: signals.lastOnAirDate is null in this file; signals.lastOnAirOffsetHours (hours relative to the demo epoch, negative = in the past) is the stored form the loader materializes.
_meta.mirrorNote: Top-level category, subcategory, brandPersonality, price_usd/currentSellingPrice, offerType, urgencyCue, presentedBy and mediaFormat are FLAT MIRRORS of nested fields, because core.extractTouches reads product[source] with no path support. reflexConfig.ts sources them. See README.md.
_meta.provenance: Wholly fictional. Brands, items, hosts, prices and copy are invented for the demo; the SCHEMA mirrors QVC published fields 1:1 (recon §A7/§B3). No real QVC or vendor product data is present.
_meta.voice: Merchandising copy follows recon §D3: spoken second person, em-dash asides, exclamation points, ℠/® on proprietary offer names. The §"DO NOT USE" vocabulary is validated absent at build time.
